name: What are common signs that my home's electrical lighting system needs safety upgrades?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs that my home's electrical lighting system needs safety upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Look for flickering lights, frequently tripping breakers, outlets that spark, or a persistent burning smell. Warm or discolored switch plates or outlets can also indicate issues. Older homes, especially those built before the 1970s, may have outdated wiring like knob-and-tube or aluminum wiring, which can pose significant fire hazards. Addressing these signs proactively can prevent serious electrical problems and ensure your home's safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Flickering lights, tripping breakers, sparking outlets, or a burning smell are common signs. Older homes often need updates due to outdated wiring.
